Olivia: Quick idea — sunset B-sides + short-film pairing for tonight. Drop one underrated track (B-side/single/remix) and a short film <=15m. I'll compile a playlist and stream at 7pm. :sunset:

Devin: Love it. I'll start — A) 'Silver Line (B-side)' — The Lowlines + 'World of Tomorrow' (Don Hertzfeldt). micro-sci-fi, perfect dusk energy. :+1:

Maya: B) 'Tape Hiss' — Nightpaper. Moody lo-fi. Pair with 'The Black Hole' (Phil & Olly) — weird lil short. :laughing:

Kai: C) 'Velvet Drawer (remix)' — Arco. super warm. Pair w/ 'Piper' (Pixar short) — cute and brief. :heart:

Olivia: D) 'Morning Static' — Fieldfox (soft outro). Pair w/ 'Feast' (Disney short) — 6m and wholesome.

Maya: Vote A/B/C/D by reacting with that letter emoji. I'll add any links people paste. :ballot_box:

Devin: A :thumbsup:

Kai: C :raised_hands:
